purpose: Defines the future response shape for a re-planning decision after a delay injection request. This contract is read-only and does not execute optimization, simulation, solver calls, scripts, commands, or backend jobs.

future_endpoint.reason: The endpoint is intentionally disabled until validation, persistence, job isolation, solver execution boundaries, rollback strategy, and audit logging are implemented.

scope.dissertation_boundary: The platform can remain extensible, but the dissertation analysis should stay centered on delays and delay propagation.

simulation_id.description: Identifier of the simulation state used as the baseline for the re-planning decision.

delay_injection_request_id.description: Identifier of the delay injection request that triggered the future re-planning analysis.

policy_id.description: Identifier of the re-planning policy evaluated for the disturbed state.

baseline_solution_id.description: Identifier of the original plan before the delay was injected.

candidate_solution_id.description: Identifier of the candidate plan produced by the future re-planning process. It remains optional while execution is disabled.

validation_rules: The response must reference an existing simulation_id.
The response must reference an existing delay_injection_request_id.
The selected policy must be explicitly identified.
Feasibility, performance, stability, computational cost, and delay propagation fields must be present together.
No response may claim that a solver, optimizer, script, or backend job was executed while execution_enabled is false.
The response must distinguish a planned response contract from an actual executed re-planning result.
quality_requirements: The contract must be deterministic and machine-readable.
The contract must preserve enough information for statistical comparison across policies.
The contract must expose stability impact separately from performance impact.
The contract must expose computational cost separately from route quality.
The contract must support future auditability of why a policy was selected or rejected.
The contract must support dissertation-focused analysis of delay propagation.
safety_requirements: This contract must not execute solvers.
This contract must not execute optimization.
This contract must not execute simulation steps.
This contract must not write files.
This contract must not mutate project state.
This contract must not expose a live POST endpoint while current_endpoint_enabled is false.
This contract must not be presented as a production decision engine.
conservative_note: This file only defines the future response shape for re-planning decisions. It does not execute experiments, solvers, scripts, commands, optimization, simulation, persistence, or operational changes.
